title: The Last Flame
provenance: Reported by WWWcool (highball#99, 2026-09-14): Apple M1 Pro, macOS 14.5, Highball 0.9.12, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, DXVK: the menu comes up, pressing Start does nothing. Measured here 2026-09-19 with the free Prologue (Steam 2517810, same Unity 2021.3 build) on an M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, blind (session locked: logs and process state only).
notes: Unity 2021.3 with a 2560x1440 H.264 video behind the menu, played through Windows Media Foundation and handed to Direct3D 11 as a shared texture. On the r5 engine (Wine 10) the video fails inside Wine's MF transform after the frames decode (Player.log: WindowsVideoMedia error 0x80004004, IMFSourceReader::WaitForSample; Wine: source_reader_process_sample Transform failed to process output), with the hardware and the software H.264 decoder alike. On the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r10) the frames decode and keep flowing, but Unity asks DXGI for a shared handle every frame and DXMT returns none (Got null handle from IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle), and DXVK cannot create the shared texture at all (VK_KHR_external_memory_win32). So no mode shows the video today. Whether Start hangs on that video could not be checked blind (Enter, Space and a centre click did nothing). The menu itself renders under DXMT and the game stays alive.

knownIssues.symptom: Pressing Start in the menu does nothing (reported); the menu's background video never shows
knownIssues.cause: measured: the game's video path needs a Direct3D 11 shared texture, which no macOS mode provides, and on Wine 10 the decode hand-off fails before that
knownIssues.fix: None yet. Needs shared-resource support in DXMT (or Wine 11's decode plus a sharing path); tracked in highball#99
